# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 12 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 12 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_012_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 12

**12:1** When Mary had finished the purple and scarlet portions, she brought them to the priest. He blessed her and said: "Mary, God has made your name great, and every generation on earth will call you blessed."

**12:2** Mary's heart was full. She went to visit her relative Elizabeth and knocked on the door. When Elizabeth heard the knock, she dropped the scarlet thread she was working on, ran to the door, flung it open, and when she saw Mary she cried out with a blessing: "Why am I so honored, that the mother of my Lord should come to see me? The child inside me just jumped for joy at the sound of your voice!"

**12:3** In that moment, Mary forgot everything the angel Gabriel had told her. She looked up toward heaven and asked in wonder: "Lord, who am I that all the generations of the earth will call me blessed?"

**12:4** She stayed with Elizabeth for three months. Her belly was growing bigger every day, and eventually fear got the better of her. She went back home and stayed out of sight, keeping herself hidden from the people of Israel. She was sixteen years old when all of this happened to her.
